description: This file implements a set of functions for processing SOAP messages related to the CCSP CWMP protocol. It includes functions for parsing SOAP headers, handling various CWMP request methods (like SetParameterValues, GetParameterValues, AddObject, Reboot, Download, Upload, etc.), and processing specific XML nodes to extract parameters and invoke corresponding interface methods. It appears to be part of a larger system handling TR-069 CWMP protocol communication, with emphasis on XML parsing, SOAP message handling, and interface invocation.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CcspCwmpSoappoProcessSoapHeader(ANSC_HANDLE hCwmpSoapHeader,PCHAR pNameSpace,ANSC_HANDLE hXmlHandle)
methods.description: Parses the CWMP SOAP header, extracting information such as ID, HoldRequests and NoMoreRequests attributes and updating the header structure accordingly.
